runs.question: What does the memo require agencies to do within 180 days?

answer.text:
Several OMB memos set 180-day deadlines. The passages don't say which one you mean, so I've covered the ones that do.

**M-25-21 (April 2025):** Within 180 days of the memo's issuance, or of any update to it, each agency must send OMB a compliance plan showing how it will become consistent with the memo, or a written determination that it does not use and does not expect to use covered AI. The agency must also post that document on its website. Agencies must also include plans to update any existing internal AI principles and guidelines to ensure consistency with this memorandum. The same passage says the deadline repeats every two years until 2036.

**M-24-10 (March 2024):** This earlier memo sets the same 180-day compliance-plan requirement. Each agency must submit to OMB and post publicly on the agency's website either a plan to achieve consistency with this memorandum, or a written determination that the agency does not use and does not anticipate using covered AI. OMB will provide templates for these compliance plans.

**M-25-22 (April 2025):** The consolidated action table lists a 180-day item stating that each agency must achieve full compliance with the memo's guidance. The extracted text is garbled, so I can only confirm that item from the table's layout.

**Which governs:** The passages don't say whether M-25-21 replaces M-24-10. Both contain the same compliance-plan requirement, so the 180-day obligation is the same under either. If you meant a specific memo, let me know and I can narrow the answer.

runs.question: What does the memo require agencies to do within 180 days? I mean OMB M-25-21, the April 2025 memo.

answer.text:
Under OMB M-25-21, agencies must produce a compliance plan within 180 days. Specifically, within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum or any update to this memorandum, and every two years thereafter until 2036, each agency must send OMB a plan for becoming consistent with the memo, or a written determination that it does not use and does not expect to use covered AI. The agency must also post the document publicly on its website. Agencies must additionally plan to update their existing internal AI principles and guidelines so they match the memo, and OMB will provide templates for these compliance plans.

**Correction to my earlier answer:** I said the passages didn't show whether M-25-21 replaces M-24-10. They do. M-25-21 rescinds and replaces Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Memorandum M-24-10, Advancing Governance, Innovation, and Risk Management for Agency Use of Artificial Intelligence. So M-25-21 governs, and the M-24-10 compliance-plan requirement I described is no longer the operative rule. The earlier M-25-22 table item is also a different memo. It concerns that memo's own guidance, not M-25-21's, and the extracted text is garbled, so I can't rely on it for M-25-21.

Under OMB M-25-21, agencies must produce a compliance plan within 180 days. Specifically, within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum or any update to this memorandum, and every two years thereafter until 2036, each agency must send OMB a plan for becoming consistent with the memo, or a written determination that it does not use and does not expect to use covered AI. The agency must also post the document publicly on its website. Agencies must additionally plan to update their existing internal AI principles and guidelines so they match the memo, and OMB will provide templates for these compliance plans.

**Correction to my earlier answer:** I said the passages didn't show whether M-25-21 replaces M-24-10. They do. M-25-21 rescinds and replaces Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Memorandum M-24-10, Advancing Governance, Innovation, and Risk Management for Agency Use of Artificial Intelligence. So M-25-21 governs, and the M-24-10 compliance-plan requirement I described is no longer the operative rule. The earlier M-25-22 table item is also a different memo. It concerns that memo's own guidance, not M-25-21's, and the extracted text is garbled, so I can't rely on it for M-25-21.
